document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
When your senses clear, you find yourself wrapped in heavy 
pelts, confined, surrounded by dark presences. You cry out, but 
strong hands steady you. A deep voice speaks: “We found you 
wandering in the woods. Rest. Soon we shall reach the fort. You’ll 
be safe there.”

Your rescuers are Tsuut’ina hunters. You lie in the bottom 
of a canoe while they paddle downstream. You rest quietly, too 
weak to ask questions.

As they promise, you eventually reach Fort McDonald. The 
Mounties give you warm clothes and a hot meal before asking 
what happened to your companions.
